changes.message: Initial release of FolioSpace with core CV builder, templates, and basic user accounts.
Introduced user authentication system, email/password workflow, and session management.
Added multiple resume templates and improved template rendering performance.
Optimized frontend layout, improved mobile responsiveness, and fixed form validation errors.
Migrated backend to a modular API structure and refactored database layer for scalability.
Upgraded Next.js version and resolved multiple SSR hydration mismatches.
Released new dashboard interface, analytics page, and improved user onboarding flow.
Patched CV autosave bug and improved rich text editor stability.
Major redesign introducing the new FolioSpace UI system, updated brand colors, and improved component library.
Added drag-and-drop CV section reordering and improved template export accuracy.
Refactored API routes for performance, implemented strict schema validation.
Implemented user avatars, profile management, and improved account settings UI.
Added support for PDF export improvements and fixed font rendering inconsistencies.
Introduced blog section, admin posting tools, and server-side content validation.
Improved server caching strategy and reduced cold start times.
Added multi-template resume preview and fixed export alignment issues.
Revamped billing UI and prepared subscription infrastructure.
Improved responsive layout and enhanced large-screen typography.
Fixed navbar alignment and improved cross-device responsiveness.
Stabilized UI component rendering during build checks.
Resolved build-time validation issues.
Optimized page loading performance and reduced render overhead.
Fixed runtime error affecting dynamic routes.
Patched minor component error in layout rendering.
Fixed UI state initialization issue.
Corrected loading sequence bug in page transitions.
Stabilized authentication check during refresh.
Introduced new UI components for upcoming features.
Released new version with structure improvements.
Updated dependency handling and resolved minor build issues.
Corrected configuration mismatch causing build warnings.
Improved directory path handling for components.
Resolved unexpected server action behavior.
Improved environment configuration and error reporting.
Cleaned deprecated API usage in internal components.
Fixed minor UI rendering issue.
Resolved error affecting form validation.
Improved fallback logic for API responses.
Enhanced error tracking on client interactions.
Improved internal test checks.
Adjusted console logging for better debugging.
General stability updates.
Fixed critical issue causing render interruption.
fix(blog-list): prevent premature 'No posts found' flash and improve loading logic by waiting for hydrated posts; ensure smooth transitions, stronger typing, and reduced unnecessary re-renders
Added premium subscription system, enforced CV download limits for free users, and patched React Server Components RCE vulnerability.
fixed blog metadata
